title: pua_xmpp Module
content_markdown: This module is a gateway for presence between SIP and XMPP.
overview: This module is a gateway for presence between SIP and XMPP.
how_it_works: It translates one format into another and uses xmpp, pua and presence modules to manage the transmition of presence state information.

exported_parameters.name: server_address
exported_parameters.description: The IP address of the server.

exported_parameters.name: presence_server
exported_parameters.description: The the address of the presence server. If set, it will be used as outbound proxy when sending PUBLISH requests.

exported_functions.name: pua_xmpp_notify
exported_functions.description: Function that handles Notify messages addressed to a user from an xmpp domain. It requires filtering after method and domain in configuration file. If the function is successful, a 2xx reply must be sent.

exported_functions.name: pua_xmpp_req_winfo

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: value of Expires header field in received Subscribe.

exported_functions.description: Function called when a Subscribe addressed to a user from a xmpp domain is received. It calls sending a Subscribe for winfo for the user, and the following Notify with dialog-info is translated into a subscription in xmpp. It also requires filtering in configuration file, after method, domain and event(only for presence).
